scope: Administrator-authored channel description, topology revision and R01-R03 visual integration

checks.name: Admin mutation and ACL
checks.observation: Unit and route-event tests cover administrator guard, member rejection, clear operation, malformed input, conflict, revision lock, metadata-only audit and successful topology event. Full Go suite passed.

checks.name: Actual Vue administrator flow
checks.observation: Chromium 1440x900 and 390x844 sent one PATCH with expected_revision=1; fixture response revision=2 was loaded back into the editor. Confirmation remained visible, page errors 0 and no horizontal overflow.

checks.name: R01-R03 final actual versus unchanged PNG
checks.observation: RGB MAE R01 3.405, R02 3.627, R03 3.984 with server-authored description fixture. Actual, absolute diff and reference SHA-256 are in the visual report. Web 924 tests, build and contract verifier passed.

checks.name: Live PostgreSQL and strict pixel acceptance
checks.observation: Browser API is fixture-backed, not a deployed database or LiveKit session. A disposable-schema PostgreSQL integration test is included; local run skipped because VOICE_PLATFORM_TEST_DATABASE_URL is unset. Backend CI provides PostgreSQL and will execute it. Remaining visual differences are visible in R01-R03 diffs; 1:1 gate remains open.
